dedupe_keys.name: enhydris hydro meteorological time series database

description: Enhydris is a web application for storing and serving hydrological and meteorological measurements. Its repository describes a database and browser interface for station metadata and observation time series. An operator loads measurement records and metadata; users can inspect or retrieve series for the stations made public by that deployment. Geographic coverage therefore follows the deploying agency, not a fixed global dataset. GitHub metadata states AGPL-3.0 licensing for the software. A limitation is that running the platform does not ensure consistent calibration, complete records or public access to a particular deployment. Data ownership and endpoint terms must be checked with each operator. Enhydris can organise rainfall, flow and groundwater observations used to calibrate flood or water-supply models. The related catalogue ERA5 record is a gridded reanalysis product, not a station database service. No deployment, measurements or package was downloaded.
name: Enhydris hydro-meteorological time-series database
